thread:
alana: Opening PR #5071 — migrating old 'tool' examples to the new callable-schema and adding a one-page cheat sheet for quick product signoff. Includes tiny cURL + JS + Python examples. Pls review links and wording.

mike: Awesome. Can you keep one compatibility example for users still on the old endpoint? We should avoid breaking copy-paste guides.

alana: Good call. I'll add a short compatibility note and link to the migration guide. The main example will demonstrate the new 'callable' shape.

jeff: For the cheat sheet, can we have a single minimal request -> full response snippet that uses streaming and final-assembly? Non-stream snippet for beginners + one streaming snippet for advanced users.

tara: Also add a quick guardrails note: suggest using a JSON schema with required fields to avoid partial parse surprises. Example schema suggestion: ```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": {"type": "string"},
    "params": {"type": "object"}
  },
  "required": ["action"]
}
```

mike: Small nit: under 'parsing tips' mention the SDK helper 'parse_structured' so folks don't roll their own fragile logic. Include a fallback snippet for trailing commas / stray chars.

alana: Added parse_structured references in both JS and Python examples. For streaming assembly I used a simple line-buffer pattern — here's the Python streaming example I added: ```py
buf = ""
async for piece in resp.stream_text():
    buf += piece
    try:
        out = parse_structured(buf)  # helper that tolerates partials
    except ValueError:
        continue
    break
```

jeff: Can we include one unit test in tests/docs_examples/test_cheatsheet.py to assert the posted example actually parses? Prevents bitrot.

alana: Yep, pushed tests + updated README links.

linkbot: LinkCheck: 1 broken link detected in changed files (/old/migration-guide).

mike: Probably the migration doc moved. I think the new path is /migration/functions-guide.

alana: Updated the link in the PR to /migration/functions-guide and pushed.

linkbot: LinkCheck: all links OK.

tara: Editorial: reword the guardrails paragraph to be more actionable. Suggest a 3-item checklist: require fields, include example values, show parse fallback.

alana: Done. Reworded and trimmed the cheat sheet to fit product page constraints. Kept full examples in the docs repo and added the 1-page md in /examples/cheatsheets/function-call.md.

jeff: LGTM from me.

mike: Looks good. +1 on tests.

alana: Merging in 30m unless anyone objects.

mike: No objections.

alana: Thanks everyone! Will follow up with a short tweet thread and a product blurb for the release notes.
